latest.headline: StoryVS_TTV Extends Unbeaten Run in Portugal
latest.paragraph: StoryVS_TTV continued their flawless start to Season 5 by securing victory at the Rally Portugal. Despite a 5000ms penalty on stage four, the Hyundai driver maintained control by winning seven of the eight stages to finish with an overall time of 01:00:25.317. GTI_1990 kept the pressure on throughout the event to secure second place, backed by a strong performance in the Power Stage. Meanwhile, Tuinboon27 demonstrated resilience, claiming victory in the final stage to bolster their points tally despite earlier time penalties, rounding out a challenging weekend for the WRC2 field.
